canonical_title: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash-1017 checkpoint and MIT-licensed weights
treatment: Repeat only for official availability, licensing, benchmark methodology corrections, independently reproducible performance findings, or major deployment breakage.
known_facts: On 2026-10-17 DeepSeek published the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 checkpoint on Hugging Face with model weights licensed MIT.
Official model card reports DeepSWE v1.1 77.0 versus prior V4.1-Flash 74.2 and Terminal-Bench 4.0 42.3 versus 31.2; scores are vendor-reported.
Model card describes shorter task completion time and outputs, a 1M-token context window, and compatibility with agent harnesses.
Coverage is for the 1017 checkpoint, not the earlier August V4-Flash release.
reinclude_only_if: Independent evaluation confirms or challenges task-level improvements.
API alias or model weights availability materially changes.
Model card or technical report substantially revises specs or license.
notes: Official Hugging Face model card confirms weights and MIT license. Scores are not independent validation.
